_about: v411 - the DEVELOPER'S OWN launch material for a project that is not on the Land Department project register. Every value is DEVELOPER_CLAIMED: transcribed as printed, never corrected, never from a portal. scripts/build_investor_facts.py reads every file in this folder and attaches it, as developer says with date and source line, to the project whose register project id (building and unit register) or name it names. A figure is kept here only if it can be read on the named page.
